cases.title: Retry loop ignores the Retry-After header
cases.summary: After a 429 response the client retries immediately and keeps going until its budget is spent.
cases.expected: It waits for the interval named in Retry-After, then retries once.
cases.actual: About forty identical requests in ten seconds, all answered with 429.

cases.title: Agent repeats an identical tool call endlessly after an empty result
cases.summary: When a search tool returns no rows, the agent calls it again with the same arguments instead of changing its approach.
cases.expected: After one empty result it broadens the query or gives up with an explanation.
cases.actual: The same call is made thirty times until the step limit stops the run.

cases.title: Backoff has no upper cap and sleeps for hours
cases.summary: The delay doubles on every failure with no maximum, so after a long outage the worker waits many hours before trying again.
cases.expected: The delay is capped at a few minutes.
cases.actual: The sixteenth wait lasts over nine hours and the job looks hung.

cases.title: Parallel tool calls exhaust the connection pool
cases.summary: The model emits twenty tool calls at once and each opens its own database connection, so the pool runs dry and later calls fail.
cases.expected: Calls are queued or limited to the pool size.
cases.actual: Half of the calls fail with pool timeout errors.

cases.title: Optional field omitted from a call is rejected with 400
cases.summary: The search tool refuses requests that leave out the optional limit argument even though the schema marks it as optional.
cases.expected: The default limit of ten is applied.
cases.actual: The tool answers 400 with the message limit is required.

cases.title: Structured output drops a nested array
cases.summary: A response schema with a nested array of objects comes back with the array present but empty.
cases.expected: The nested array contains the extracted items.
cases.actual: The array is empty although the source text lists several entries.

cases.title: JSON output ends with a trailing comma and fails to parse
cases.summary: The model sometimes appends a comma after the last property of an object, so the strict parser throws.
cases.expected: Valid JSON that parses on the first try.
cases.actual: Unexpected token errors on roughly one answer in twenty.

cases.title: Enum value returned in the wrong case fails validation
cases.summary: The model answers with the value Open where the schema only accepts open, and validation rejects the whole payload.
cases.expected: One of the exact lower-case values from the schema.
cases.actual: Validation fails with an invalid enum value error.

cases.title: Timestamps come back in local time without an offset
cases.summary: Dates produced by the tool carry no timezone, so the scheduler reads them as UTC and fires jobs hours off.
cases.expected: ISO 8601 timestamps with an explicit offset.
cases.actual: Meetings are created three hours early.

cases.title: Numbers returned as strings break the schema
cases.summary: Prices are returned inside quotes, so downstream arithmetic concatenates text instead of adding.
cases.expected: Numeric fields are numbers.
cases.actual: The total of 2 and 3 becomes 23.

cases.title: Oldest messages are dropped when the context window fills
cases.summary: Once the conversation exceeds the window the framework silently removes the earliest turns, including the task statement.
cases.expected: The task statement is pinned and only middle turns are trimmed.
cases.actual: Later in the run the assistant no longer knows what it was asked to do.

cases.title: Conversation summary loses the user constraint
cases.summary: The rolling summary keeps the topic but drops the instruction to never touch the production database.
cases.expected: Hard constraints survive every summarisation.
cases.actual: Fifty turns later the assistant runs a migration on production.

cases.title: A huge tool output floods the context
cases.summary: A directory listing of forty thousand files is pasted whole into the prompt and crowds out everything else.
cases.expected: Large outputs are truncated or summarised with a pointer to the rest.
cases.actual: The next step fails because the window is full.

cases.title: Edits made earlier are forgotten after compaction
cases.summary: After the history is compacted the assistant no longer remembers which files it already changed and edits them a second time.
cases.expected: A list of modified files is kept across compaction.
cases.actual: The same function is patched twice and the second patch breaks the first.

cases.title: Duplicate messages inflate the token count
cases.summary: The same user message is appended twice on every retry, doubling the tokens billed for the conversation.
cases.expected: Each message appears once in the history.
cases.actual: Cost per run is double the estimate.

cases.title: The wrong tool is picked when two tools have similar names
cases.summary: With tools named get_user and get_users the model keeps choosing the single-record one for list requests.
cases.expected: The listing tool is used for list requests.
cases.actual: Only the first user is ever returned.

cases.title: Vague tool description leads to wrong arguments
cases.summary: The description says only runs a query, so the model passes a natural-language question where SQL is required.
cases.expected: The description states the expected input format with an example.
cases.actual: The database rejects every call as a syntax error.

cases.title: Tool timeout is not propagated so the agent waits forever
cases.summary: The wrapper sets a thirty second timeout on the HTTP call but the agent loop has no limit, so a hung tool blocks the whole run.
cases.expected: A timeout error is returned to the model after thirty seconds.
cases.actual: The run is stuck for hours.

cases.title: Tool output cut at ten thousand characters hides the error at the end
cases.summary: Long build logs are truncated to the first ten thousand characters, but the failure message is printed last.
cases.expected: The tail of the log is kept or the error is extracted.
cases.actual: The model sees a successful start and reports that the build passed.

cases.title: Stale tool schema cache leads to a call to a removed tool
cases.summary: The client caches the tool list for a day, so after a tool is deleted the model still calls it and gets not found.
cases.expected: The cache is refreshed when the server version changes.
cases.actual: Calls to the removed tool fail with 404.

cases.title: Unicode in arguments breaks shell escaping
cases.summary: A filename with an accented letter is passed to a shell command unquoted and the command fails.
cases.expected: Arguments are quoted or passed as a list.
cases.actual: No such file or directory for a file that exists.

cases.title: Relative path resolves against the wrong working directory
cases.summary: The agent writes to ./notes.txt but the tool runs in a different folder, so the file ends up outside the project.
cases.expected: Paths resolve against the project root.
cases.actual: The file is created in the home directory.

cases.title: File write succeeds but a later read returns the old content
cases.summary: The agent edits a config file, then reads it back through a cached helper and sees the version from before the edit.
cases.expected: Reads always reflect the latest write.
cases.actual: The agent concludes the edit failed and repeats it.

cases.title: Model claims the task is done without running the tests
cases.summary: At the end of a coding task the assistant writes that all tests pass, but the test command was never executed.
cases.expected: It runs the suite and reports the real result.
cases.actual: The summary says green while the suite has failures.

cases.title: Hallucinated function name in generated code
cases.summary: The model calls a method that does not exist in the library version in use, and the program raises AttributeError.
cases.expected: Only documented methods are called.
cases.actual: Runtime error: object has no attribute.

cases.title: Answers stay in the old language after the user switches
cases.summary: The user starts in French then asks in English, but replies continue in French for the rest of the chat.
cases.expected: Replies follow the language of the latest message.
cases.actual: Every answer is in French.

cases.title: Refusal triggered by a harmless keyword
cases.summary: A request to kill a hung process is refused because the word kill appears in it.
cases.expected: The request is understood in context and carried out.
cases.actual: The assistant declines and lectures about violence.

cases.title: Agent asks permission repeatedly for the same action
cases.summary: Every time the agent wants to read a file in the repo it asks for confirmation again, even after being told yes.
cases.expected: An approval applies for the rest of the session.
cases.actual: Forty prompts for the same folder in one hour.

cases.title: Formatting instruction is ignored deep into a long chat
cases.summary: The user asks for answers as bullet points, which works at first, but after thirty messages the replies turn back to paragraphs.
cases.expected: The requested format persists.
cases.actual: Long paragraphs again.

cases.title: Streaming response is cut off mid-sentence
cases.summary: The server closes the event stream after sixty seconds, so long answers end in the middle of a word.
cases.expected: The full answer or a clear error.
cases.actual: Truncated text with no error.

cases.title: Install step hangs because the container has no network
cases.summary: pip install waits indefinitely inside a sandbox that blocks outbound traffic.
cases.expected: A fast failure with a message that the network is unavailable.
cases.actual: No output for ten minutes.

cases.title: Missing environment variable silently falls back to a default model
cases.summary: When MODEL_NAME is unset the code picks a small default model without any warning, so quality drops.
cases.expected: Startup fails with a clear message.
cases.actual: Answers get worse and nobody knows why.

cases.title: Two scheduler instances both run the same job
cases.summary: After scaling to two replicas each one executes the nightly cleanup, so records are deleted twice and counts go negative.
cases.expected: Exactly one instance runs each job.
cases.actual: Counters end up below zero.

cases.title: Race condition when two agents edit the same file
cases.summary: Two agents write to notes.md at nearly the same moment and the later write overwrites the earlier one.
cases.expected: Writes are serialised or merged.
cases.actual: One agent changes vanish.

cases.title: Out-of-memory when loading a large CSV
cases.summary: Reading a two gigabyte spreadsheet into memory at once kills the process on a small machine.
cases.expected: The file is streamed in chunks.
cases.actual: Killed with exit code 137.

cases.title: Merge conflict markers committed to the repository
cases.summary: The agent resolves a conflict by committing the file with the angle bracket markers still inside.
cases.expected: A clean merge without markers.
cases.actual: The build breaks on a syntax error at the marker line.

cases.title: Webhook delivered twice causes double processing
cases.summary: The provider retries delivery when the response is slow, and the handler charges the customer twice.
cases.expected: Handlers are idempotent on the event id.
cases.actual: Two charges for one order.

cases.title: Clock skew breaks the token expiry check
cases.summary: The auth server clock runs two minutes ahead, so freshly issued tokens look expired to the client.
cases.expected: A small tolerance for skew is allowed.
cases.actual: Every request fails with token expired right after login.

cases.title: Embedding model changed without reindexing
cases.summary: The team switched the embedding model but kept the old vectors, so every search returns unrelated documents.
cases.expected: The index is rebuilt after a model change.
cases.actual: Results look random.

cases.title: Chunking splits a code block in half
cases.summary: The splitter cuts text every thousand characters, so a function is separated from its closing brace.
cases.expected: Chunks respect code block boundaries.
cases.actual: Retrieved snippets are syntactically incomplete.

cases.title: Retrieval returns an outdated document version
cases.summary: Both the 2022 and the 2024 policy pages are indexed, and the older page ranks first for most questions.
cases.expected: The latest version wins.
cases.actual: Answers quote superseded rules.

cases.title: Vector search ignores the metadata filter
cases.summary: A query restricted to one customer still returns chunks from other customers because the filter is applied after ranking.
cases.expected: Only chunks of that customer are returned.
cases.actual: Data from other tenants appears in answers.

cases.title: PDF extraction scrambles table columns
cases.summary: Text from a two column table is read row by row across both columns, so values end up next to the wrong labels.
cases.expected: Each cell keeps its column.
cases.actual: Prices are paired with the wrong products.

cases.title: OAuth refresh token is not rotated and fails after a day
cases.summary: The integration stores the first refresh token and reuses it, but the provider invalidates it after one use.
cases.expected: The new refresh token from each response is saved.
cases.actual: 401 invalid_grant on the second day.

cases.title: CORS preflight fails for a custom header
cases.summary: The browser sends an OPTIONS request first, and the server does not list the custom header in its allowed headers.
cases.expected: The preflight answers 204 with the header allowed.
cases.actual: Blocked by CORS policy in the console.

cases.title: Cookie without a SameSite attribute causes a login loop
cases.summary: After sign in the browser drops the session cookie on the redirect, so the user lands on the login page again.
cases.expected: The session cookie is kept after the redirect.
cases.actual: Endless redirect between login and home.

cases.title: Pagination cursor reused after expiry returns the first page forever
cases.summary: A saved cursor is sent after it expired and the API silently restarts from page one, so the crawler never finishes.
cases.expected: An expired cursor returns an error.
cases.actual: Infinite crawl over the same hundred items.

cases.title: Idempotency key reused with a different body is accepted
cases.summary: Sending the same Idempotency-Key with changed parameters replays the first response instead of rejecting it.
cases.expected: A conflict error for a mismatched body.
cases.actual: The client believes the second request succeeded.

cases.title: Sorting numbers as text puts ten before two
cases.summary: Version labels are sorted alphabetically, so 10 comes before 2 in the release list.
cases.expected: Natural numeric order.
cases.actual: The latest release is shown in the middle of the list.

cases.title: Off-by-one in a date range drops the last day
cases.summary: A report for 1 to 31 January uses a less-than comparison on the end date and omits the 31st.
cases.expected: The whole month is included.
cases.actual: Totals are missing one day of sales.

cases.title: SQL query without an index scans the whole table
cases.summary: A lookup by email on a table of ten million rows takes eight seconds because no index covers the column.
cases.expected: Sub-millisecond lookups.
cases.actual: Full table scan in the query plan.

cases.title: Unicode normalization mismatch in username lookup
cases.summary: A name typed with a combining accent does not match the stored precomposed form.
cases.expected: Both spellings find the same account.
cases.actual: User not found for visually identical names.

cases.title: Uploaded photo appears rotated by ninety degrees
cases.summary: Phone images carry an orientation tag that the resizing step discards.
cases.expected: Images are shown upright.
cases.actual: Portrait pictures are sideways.

cases.title: Decimal comma breaks number parsing
cases.summary: A price typed as 12,50 by a German user is parsed as 1250.
cases.expected: Locale-aware parsing.
cases.actual: Orders are a hundred times too expensive.

cases.title: Cron job overlaps itself when a run is slow
cases.summary: The hourly import takes seventy minutes on busy days and a second copy starts while the first is still working.
cases.expected: A new run waits for the previous one.
cases.actual: Duplicate rows in the import table.

cases.title: Log lines carry no request id
cases.summary: Messages from one request are interleaved with others and cannot be followed.
cases.expected: A correlation id on every line.
cases.actual: Tracing a failure takes an afternoon.

cases.title: Feature flag evaluated on every render causes flicker
cases.summary: The flag service answers slowly, so a banner appears and disappears while the page loads.
cases.expected: A stable value for the whole page view.
cases.actual: Visible flashing of the banner.

cases.title: Memory grows because websocket listeners are never removed
cases.summary: Each reconnect adds another handler and the old ones stay referenced.
cases.expected: Handlers are removed on disconnect.
cases.actual: The tab uses two gigabytes after a day.

cases.title: Library upgrade silently changes the default connect timeout
cases.summary: After a minor release connections that used to wait thirty seconds give up after five.
cases.expected: No behaviour change in a minor version.
cases.actual: Sporadic connection errors in the evening.

cases.title: Build cache serves stale static assets
cases.summary: The content hash is not part of the file name, so browsers keep the previous bundle.
cases.expected: New deploys are picked up at once.
cases.actual: Users see the old interface until they clear data.

cases.title: Marketing email looks broken in dark mode
cases.summary: A white logo on a transparent background disappears when the mail client inverts colours.
cases.expected: Readable in both themes.
cases.actual: Invisible header.

cases.title: Yearly subscription renewal fails on leap day
cases.summary: A plan started on the twenty ninth of February has no matching date in other years.
cases.expected: Renewal on the last day of February.
cases.actual: The customer is never charged.

cases.title: Symlink loop crashes the directory walker
cases.summary: A link pointing to its own parent makes the recursive scan run until the stack overflows.
cases.expected: Loops are detected and skipped.
cases.actual: RecursionError after several minutes.

cases.title: Large upload fails behind the reverse proxy
cases.summary: The proxy allows only one megabyte per body and answers with a bare gateway error.
cases.expected: Files up to fifty megabytes are accepted.
cases.actual: Error 413 for any video.

cases.title: TLS handshake fails because the intermediate certificate is missing
cases.summary: The server presents only its own certificate and some clients cannot build the chain.
cases.expected: The full chain is served.
cases.actual: Unable to verify the first certificate on old Android.

cases.title: DNS cache keeps pointing to the old address after the migration
cases.summary: The resolver honours a one day TTL that was set before the move.
cases.expected: Traffic reaches the new servers within minutes.
cases.actual: Half the users still hit the retired host.

cases.title: Regular expression with catastrophic backtracking
cases.summary: A validation pattern with nested quantifiers freezes on a long line of repeated characters.
cases.expected: Linear time matching.
cases.actual: One request pins a processor core.

cases.title: Database connections leak under load
cases.summary: An error path returns early without releasing the handle and the pool empties.
cases.expected: Every connection is returned.
cases.actual: All requests hang after an hour of traffic.

cases.title: Two transactions deadlock on the same pair of rows
cases.summary: One updates account A then B while another updates B then A.
cases.expected: A consistent lock order.
cases.actual: Deadlock detected errors in the logs.

cases.title: Mobile app crashes when started without a connection
cases.summary: The launch screen assumes the profile request succeeds and dereferences an empty response.
cases.expected: A friendly offline state.
cases.actual: Immediate crash on airplane mode.

cases.title: Keyboard focus is lost when a dialog closes
cases.summary: After dismissing the modal the focus returns to the top of the document.
cases.expected: Focus returns to the button that opened it.
cases.actual: Keyboard users must tab through the whole page again.

cases.title: Layout overflows on very narrow screens
cases.summary: A fixed width table forces horizontal scrolling at three hundred twenty pixels.
cases.expected: The page fits the viewport.
cases.actual: Content is cut off on small phones.

cases.title: Web font fallback shifts the layout
cases.summary: The system font is wider than the brand font, so text reflows when the font arrives.
cases.expected: No visible jump.
cases.actual: Buttons move under the cursor.

cases.title: Dark theme text has low contrast
cases.summary: Grey captions on a charcoal background measure two to one.
cases.expected: At least four and a half to one.
cases.actual: Hard to read in sunlight.

cases.title: Double click on checkout creates two orders
cases.summary: The submit button stays enabled while the request is in flight.
cases.expected: One order per purchase.
cases.actual: Customers are charged twice by accident.

cases.title: Search box fires a request on every keystroke
cases.summary: There is no debounce, so typing a word sends a dozen calls.
cases.expected: One call after the user pauses.
cases.actual: The suggestion list flickers and lags.

cases.title: Infinite scroll loads the same page twice
cases.summary: A scroll event fires twice near the bottom and both handlers request the next offset.
cases.expected: Each page is fetched once.
cases.actual: Repeated entries in the feed.

cases.title: Cache stampede right after expiry
cases.summary: A popular key expires and hundreds of workers recompute it at the same moment.
cases.expected: A single worker refreshes it.
cases.actual: The database spikes to full load.

cases.title: Health check stays green while the database is down
cases.summary: The probe only checks that the process answers HTTP.
cases.expected: Unhealthy when dependencies fail.
cases.actual: The balancer keeps sending traffic to a broken node.

cases.title: Graceful shutdown drops in-flight requests
cases.summary: The server exits on the termination signal without draining connections.
cases.expected: Open requests finish first.
cases.actual: Users see errors during every deploy.

cases.title: Log rotation is off and the disk fills
cases.summary: A verbose debug level writes forty gigabytes a day to a single file.
cases.expected: Old logs are compressed and removed.
cases.actual: No space left on device at night.

cases.title: Backups exist but nobody tried a restore
cases.summary: The nightly dump is written to storage and never opened.
cases.expected: A tested recovery procedure.
cases.actual: The first restore attempt finds a corrupt archive.

cases.title: Unit test depends on today date
cases.summary: A fixture hardcodes a deadline that has now passed.
cases.expected: Tests use a fixed clock.
cases.actual: The suite went red on the first of the month.

cases.title: Flaky test caused by shared global state
cases.summary: Two tests mutate the same singleton and pass or fail depending on order.
cases.expected: Isolated tests.
cases.actual: Random red builds.

cases.title: Snapshot tests updated without reading the diff
cases.summary: A reviewer accepts every changed snapshot in one click.
cases.expected: Changes are reviewed.
cases.actual: A real regression slipped into the baseline.

cases.title: Lint rule disabled across the whole repository
cases.summary: A noisy warning was switched off globally instead of being fixed.
cases.expected: Targeted exceptions only.
cases.actual: New violations pile up unnoticed.

cases.title: CI ignores the lockfile
cases.summary: The pipeline runs a plain install, so builds pick up newer minor versions.
cases.expected: Reproducible installs.
cases.actual: A green build on Monday fails on Tuesday.

cases.title: Container image runs as the root user
cases.summary: The Dockerfile never sets a user, so the service has full privileges inside the container.
cases.expected: A dedicated unprivileged user.
cases.actual: A scanner flags the image as critical.

cases.title: Infrastructure code and reality have drifted apart
cases.summary: Someone resized a server by hand and the next plan wants to revert it.
cases.expected: Changes go through code.
cases.actual: Surprising destroy and create actions.

cases.title: Pod stuck in a restart loop because of a wrong entrypoint
cases.summary: The image starts a shell that exits at once, so the orchestrator keeps recreating it.
cases.expected: The service process stays in the foreground.
cases.actual: CrashLoopBackOff with exit code zero.

cases.title: Poison message blocks the queue consumer
cases.summary: A malformed payload throws on every attempt and is redelivered forever.
cases.expected: Failed messages move to a dead letter queue.
cases.actual: Nothing behind it is processed.

cases.title: Event order is not guaranteed across partitions
cases.summary: Updates for one customer land on different partitions and are applied out of sequence.
cases.expected: Per-customer ordering.
cases.actual: Balances flip between old and new values.

cases.title: Sequential identifiers are exposed in public links
cases.summary: Order numbers increase by one, so anyone can guess the next receipt.
cases.expected: Unguessable identifiers.
cases.actual: Strangers can open other receipts.

cases.title: Page title is not updated on route change
cases.summary: The single page app keeps the first title for every screen.
cases.expected: A descriptive title per view.
cases.actual: History shows the same label everywhere.

cases.title: Spreadsheet export removes leading zeros
cases.summary: Postal codes such as 02134 are turned into numbers by the spreadsheet program.
cases.expected: Codes stay as written.
cases.actual: Addresses lose a digit.

cases.title: CSV import fails on a byte order mark
cases.summary: A file saved by a Windows editor starts with an invisible marker that ends up in the first header name.
cases.expected: The first column is recognised.
cases.actual: Unknown column error for a column that is there.

cases.title: Transcription drops speaker labels
cases.summary: Two voices in a meeting recording are merged into one block of text.
cases.expected: Turns attributed to speakers.
cases.actual: Impossible to tell who agreed to what.

cases.title: OCR confuses zero and the letter O in serial numbers
cases.summary: Scanned labels with mixed characters are read with the wrong glyphs.
cases.expected: Correct serials.
cases.actual: Warranty lookups fail.

cases.title: Translated sentence built from fragments reads wrongly
cases.summary: Strings are concatenated in code, so word order in other languages is incorrect.
cases.expected: Whole sentences with placeholders.
cases.actual: Nonsense in Japanese and German.

cases.title: Heatmap colours are not distinguishable for colour blind users
cases.summary: A red to green scale carries the whole meaning of the chart.
cases.expected: A scale that works for everyone.
cases.actual: Two categories look identical.

search surfaces obsolete guidance ahead of the current edition of the handbook
